test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.**

A French woman Jeanne Louise Calment lived for 122 years and 164 days. This made her the world’s oldest human being at the time of her ______ (1) ______ in 1997 (according to the Guinness World Records). She gave the credit of her ______ (2) ______ to routine snacking on chocolate.
solution:
The correct answer is **"demise; longevity."**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• For the first blank, the word must be close to the meaning of** "death."**
 
• **"Demise"** means death. (व्‍यक्ति का निधन)
 
 
• **Example**: *Poor business decisions led to the company owner’s **demise**__.*
 
 
 
• For
